propositions: AC checklist items carrying operational-evidence markers (deploy, prod, live-run, IaC-apply, cloud-state, merge-gate, human-action, store-surgery) without [operator-attested] tag are not flagged at plan time, causing close-gate failures requiring retroactive tagging
A deterministic, prompt-less advisory lint is needed in the p6_ac_quality rule-set that flags untagged operational-evidence AC items before claim, removing the verification round-trip
The lint must extend p6_ac_quality without adding a new P10 DET check, keeping DET_CHECKS at exactly 9 and CANONICAL_DET unchanged, to avoid touching criteria_routing.json and breaking CI

The [operator-attested] tag matcher must be single-sourced in det_operator_attested._OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE and re-exported to workflow_ops, so the plan-time lint and completion-verifier agree on what is tagged by construction

The deterministic self-gate evaluation must be committed before the lint is activated, demonstrating precision >= 70% on a >= 50-item sample, flag rate <= 5%, and both known cases (115b, 8c4f) firing on historical AC text
The lint and verifier agreement, lack of blocking posture, lexicon precision tuning, and shared regex are enforced by unit tests and the lint ships advisory in the packaged registry
